name: Stinglasher
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
In surveying the Writhing Deep, one of our scouts reported seeing a giant insect - much larger than the other insects spotted - wandering about the twisted terrain.  Not only is it larger, it also seems to secrete some sort of aura that the other insects don't.  We've given it a name - Stinglasher.

The innards of this beast would be invaluable to study as we figure out the best way to deal with this new threat.  Cut out its secretion glands and bring it back to me immediately!
narrative.objectives: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Impressive, Champion... most impressive!  If Stinglasher is indeed one of their strongest creatures, the study of the beast will prove to be quite valuable in time.  It's now my charge to make sure we defend ourselves long enough to take advantage of it.

Please accept this coin bounty as a token of the entire camp's thanks, adventurer.  Well done.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you managed to bring down Stinglasher yet?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 42 to 48, 19,250 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.

quests.objectiveText: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Stinglasher
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Report
